thread:
alice_pm: Quick sync — proposing we narrow the visibility playbook for launch to a minimal, customer-facing slice: dashboards (per-route latency + cost), tracing hooks (basic span annotations + sample IDs), and error analytics (top failure signatures + impacted users). Want to avoid scope creep and get something production-ready in 6 weeks.
ben_eng: Agree on narrow scope. Quick note: tracing hooks are the riskiest due to sampling and KV-cache correlation overhead. We can do a light-weight implementation (span attrs + sample id) for GA, but advanced span-linking should be M2.
carla_sre: From SRE POV we need per-tenant cost breakdown + alerting for error-rate regressions in GA. Also require audit logs for any trace linking changes.
dan_data: Sharing a starting metric query sketch for the dashboard (prometheus-style):
```
sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route!=""}[5m])) by (route)
# then compute p95/p99 from buckets and join with token_cost metrics
```
This will give route-level latencies and we can join with cost-per-token to estimate spend by route.
emily_prod: Can we lay out explicit launch criteria? My suggestion:
- M0 (GA): dashboards showing p50/p95/p99 by model+route, cost-by-route estimate, error signposts (top 5 signatures).
- M1: tracing hooks available for canaries and 25% of traffic, automated error grouping.
- M2: full tracing linking, per-request cold-cache attribution, exportable traces.
frank_research: Must include eval hooks so we can surface quality regressions tied to rollout. Redwood Optimize should be able to hook into the same event stream.
ben_eng: Rough engineering estimates: dashboards 2w (backend + simple UI), cost breakdown 2w (requires cost model + join), tracing hooks 3w (GA), error analytics 3w (grouping + UI). Total ~10w if all parallel, but staggered makes sense. Recommend absolute-min GA = dashboards + cost breakdown (4w) and defer tracing + full error analytics.
alice_pm: OK — proposal: GA = dashboards + cost breakdown + basic error signposts (no auto-grouping). Tracing hooks moved to M1 (canary-only GA). That should reduce launch risk and unblock customers who mainly ask for visibility into latency/cost. :+1:
carla_sre: +1. For the GA we still need alerting hooks (simple threshold alerts) and retention policy defined. Who owns alert playbooks?
emily_prod: Product will own playbooks for first 6 customers, SRE owns system alerts (latency/cost spikes). We'll document runbook in the console.
ben_eng: Technical follow-ups: 1) define sample ID format (UUID vs composite), 2) decide on tagging model (route, model_version, customer_id), 3) storage TTL for traces. I'll write a short PRD for those and tag owners.
deploy-bot: canary cluster health: 2/2 nodes healthy, no tail errors in last 30m. :white_check_mark:
alice_pm: Action items: ben -> PRD for tracing + tags (due EOD Tue), dan -> dashboard query templates + example joins (due Wed), emily -> draft launch criteria doc + 3 customer invites for early access (due Fri), carla -> alerting SLAs + retention suggestion (due Thu). We'll sync again Thu 10am. Thanks all. :rocket:
